outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes (N=4, n>100), but only bars with error bars are shown with no overlaid individual data points.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD, N=4, n>400), shown only as bars with error bars without individual data points overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod over weeks); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at different weeks); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type that is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G contains only immunofluorescence micrograph images with no plotted averages, so the check does not apply.
Panel H shows two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD, N=3, n=9 per group) with only error bars and no individual data points overlaid.
